description: Coverage policy contract — thresholds consistent, anti-cheating enforced, build gates active

rules.title: Thresholds consistent
rules.description: branches threshold must be ≤ lines threshold — branch coverage is always harder to achieve

rules.title: Thresholds realistic
rules.description: Global thresholds must be between 60% and 100% — below 60% indicates a broken policy

rules.title: No assertion-free tests
rules.description: Every it/test block must contain at least one expect() call
